Apply Now With Melissa

NMLS ID#: 1715077

How Can I Help You?

Melissa will be there for you every step of the way, creating a seamless process and a top notch home-buying experience. Her customers are her priority. She takes the necessary time and attention to fully understand your needs. Melissa goes the extra mile in order to make your path to homeownership as fast, easy and cost-effective as it can be. She will work on your schedule, and is available to answer any questions you may have, day or night.

A Little About Me

Melissa specializes in Conventional and Bi-Weekly Mortgages, Refinances, Home Equity, Construction and Land Loans. In addition, she has programs for first-time homebuyers, low down-payment options and below-market interest rates. Melissa is knowledgeable, quick, and organized.

Whether you are buying your first home, refinancing, or building your dream house, Melissa will help make your dream of homeownership a sweet reality.
